'''2008 Worlds Day 2 Dan Tartaglione LS We Have A Plan''' was the Light Side constructed list played by [[Dan Tartaglione]] at [[2008 World Championship]] (Day 2).

* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS16]]

* '''Stage:''' Day 2
